definitions.gloss: the end of the rainy season; the end of tsuyu
definitions.explanation: the official announcement by the Japan Meteorological Agency marking the end of the annual rainy season, typically in mid-July

examples.japanese: ⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{梅雨明|つゆあ}け⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The rainy season has finally ended.

examples.japanese: {梅雨明|つゆあ}け⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧きた。
examples.english: As soon as the rainy season ended, the intense heat arrived.

examples.japanese: {梅雨明|つゆあ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦{海水浴|かいすいよく}→海水浴：10972_kaisuiyoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。

FORMS:
⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ (rainy season) + ⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧ (dawn, end) → end of the rainy season
{梅雨明|つゆあ}け⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (for the rainy season to end)
⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あ}ける→明ける：21288_akeru⟧ (for the rainy season to end)

TIMING:
The Japan Meteorological Agency announces {梅雨明|つゆあ}け for each region:
- ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧: late June
- ⟦{九州|きゅうしゅう}→九州：15647_kyuushuu⟧〜⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧: mid to late July
- ⟦{東北|とうほく}→東北：27542_touhoku⟧: late July

WHAT FOLLOWS:
After {梅雨明|つゆあ}け, Japan enters ⟦{真夏|まなつ}→真夏：27793_manatsu⟧ (midsummer) with high temperatures and humidity. This is also the start of summer vacation for schools.
